world.title: 'Unprecedented' rains in Japan kill six people

world.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
world.description: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

world.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs

US.description: The board voted to close the Washington, D.C., arts complex's main campus for a $250 million renovation — three months after a federal judge temporarily blocked a similar closure.
